description:
Cron HEARTBEAT that (re)starts the singleton drain-until-empty auto-summarizer for the LLM session ledger. Each fire does ZERO summarization on the action-queue thread: it submits ONE background drainer to a single-slot executor and returns in milliseconds with `{"drainer": "started"}`, or `{"drainer": "already_running"}` if a drainer is already active (that fire is a no-op). At most one drainer runs at a time PER PROCESS — the single in-memory executor slot is the singleton guard (a blue-green swap window can briefly run two drainers over the shared DB; harm is bounded by push idempotency).

The drainer loops until nothing eligible remains: it pages `list_quiescent_sessions` (default `batch_size` 50, clamped to the read's 1..50 cap; results ordered `last_event_at` DESC / newest-first) for canonical sessions past `quiescence_minutes` (default 10) not yet embedded, and summarizes each not-yet-attempted session in SERIES via the branch ladder: (0) an operator-set custom-title seed, or (1) an existing claude_code `away_summary` recap — both written INLINE with ZERO inference; (2) the trivial sentinel for any DETERMINISTICALLY unsummarizable session (below the trivial floor, an empty timeline, OR an all-blob-offloaded/empty transcript) — these are marked so they LEAVE eligibility; else (3) a bounded transcript summarized by a SYNCHRONOUS `inference_service` completion (provider-bounded, one at a time on the drainer thread — never parks the action queue). The summary write (via `push_session_summary_chunk`) generates an embedding, stores it in the vector index, and per Gap 2(B) denormalizes the chunk text back into `session_ledger__session.summary_text`.

TWO properties. LIVENESS: an in-memory `attempted` set of ids tried this drain guarantees termination — the drainer processes only not-yet-attempted rows and stops when a page surfaces none, so even a `skipped` return (which writes no `__summary` row) cannot spin. COVERAGE: progress requires processed rows to LEAVE eligibility. Summarized rows (→ `__summary` row) and deterministic no-content skips (→ sentinel) both do, so no persistent no-content cluster can pin the DESC head page and strand older backlog behind it. Only a TRANSIENT inference-empty cluster (backend down/empty) filling the whole newest page can stall ONE drain — it is deliberately NOT sentinel-marked so a later cron-fired drain re-picks and self-resolves it. Per-session failures are caught so one bad session cannot kill the drain; a blue-green restart starts a fresh, idempotent drain.

Inference routing is still a Phase-0b stopgap superseded by Phase 5 resolver routing; the single-slot background/guard mechanism stays regardless. This is the INTERNAL summarization path; the EXTERNAL `push_session_summary_chunk` surface (spec §17.6 caller-side push) stays valid for future observer-agent integrations, and both write through the same SummaryWriter. `generated_by_client_id` is the constant `"internal:auto_summarize"` with a per-branch discriminator suffix, because no authenticated principal accompanies a system-driven cron firing.

This verb is EDGE_SINK (terminal/headless) — no `result_processor_customizations` / `error_processor_customizations`; the cron-fired action short-circuits at the EDGE_SINK_SKIP branch in `action_queue_poller`. See `21_scheduling_service/01_template_flow_record_lifecycle.md` for the terminal-cron pattern.
embedding_description: Internal cron-fired heartbeat that starts a singleton (per-process) drain-until-empty auto-summarizer over LLM session ledger sessions past quiescence and not yet embedded. Each fire submits one background drainer to a single-slot executor and returns immediately; the drainer pages list_quiescent_sessions newest-first and summarizes in series until empty via seed/recap inline or a synchronous inference fallback. An attempted-set guarantees termination; deterministic no-content skips (empty timeline, all-blob-offloaded transcript, trivial floor) are sentinel-marked so they leave eligibility and cannot pin the DESC head page, while transient inference-empty skips stay eligible and self-resolve on a later drain. Never parks the action queue.
